parts:
Hi Vincent (and everyone),

 

Thank you for all your work in developing GGIR package.

 

I work as a statistician at the University of Utah, and I am on a study of using GGIR.

 

I tried to run g.shell.GGIR function on 1 week accelerator data by setting and using the following codes, and I got an error message “Error in if (firstmidnighti == 1) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed” in part 2. But my data did start from the midnight. Could you please help me understand and adjust the error?

 

 

out=g.shell.GGIR(

 

#-------------------------------

# General parameters

#-------------------------------

mode=mode,

datadir=datadir,

outputdir=outputdir,

studyname=studyname,

f0=f0,

f1=f1,

overwrite = TRUE,

do.imp=TRUE,

idloc=1,

print.filename=FALSE,

storefolderstructure = FALSE,

 

#-------------------------------

# Part 1 parameters:

#-------------------------------

windowsizes = c(60,300,3600),

do.cal=TRUE,

do.enmo = TRUE,

do.anglez=TRUE,

chunksize=1,

printsummary=TRUE,

 

#-------------------------------

# Part 2 parameters:

#-------------------------------

strategy = 1,

hrs.del.start = 0,

hrs.del.end = 0,

includedaycrit = 10,

ilevels=c(0, 100.6, 428.8),

mvpathreshold=c(100.6,428.8, 600),

boutcriter = 0,

 

#-------------------------------

# Part 3 parameters:

#-------------------------------

timethreshold= 5,

anglethreshold=5,

ignorenonwear = TRUE,

 

#-------------------------------

# Part 4 parameters:

#-------------------------------

excludefirstlast = TRUE,

includenightcrit = 16,

def.noc.sleep = c(21, 9),

relyonsleeplog = FALSE,

 

#-----------------------------------

# Report generation

#-------------------------------

do.report = c(2,4)

 

)

 

   g.shell.GGIR {GGIR} by Vincent van Hees

 

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Part 2

 1

Error in if (firstmidnighti == 1) { :

  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

 

Thanks in advance, best regards

Qian Ding

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 2 error message "Error in if (firstmidnighti == 1) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed"
parts:
Hi Qian Ding,

How many hours of data are there in the file you are trying to analyse? It could be that the measurement is too short and does not include any midnights.

Further, I notice that you use a 60 second epoch. Nowadays hardly anyone is using that anymore because it is known to limit the sensitivity to short lasting behaviours. This setting should not impact on the ability to identify midnight, but it may still be worth checking: Can you try replacing the 60 by 5?

Best, Vincent
